Package com.tivoli.am.rba.geoLocator

Class GeolocUtils

java.lang.Object
com.tivoli.am.rba.geoLocator.GeolocUtils
public class GeolocUtils extends Object
Utility class for retrieving geolocation information based on IP addresses. This class provides a simple interface to lookup the GeoLocation database, for use in authenticated contexts and policy evaluation.

The following code snippet demonstrates retrieving geolocation attributes for an IP address: 

 // Get location attributes for an IP address
 Map<String, String> attributes = GeolocUtils.getLocationAttributes("9.77.84.65");

 // Access individual attributes
 String country = attributes.get(GeolocUtils.COUNTRY);
 String city = attributes.get(GeolocUtils.CITY);

 // Or use convenience methods
 String country = GeolocUtils.getCountry("9.77.84.65");

  • Method Details

    • getLocationAttributes

      public static Map<String,String> getLocationAttributes(String ipAddress)
      Retrieve geolocation attributes for the specified IP address.

      This method queries the geolocation database and returns a map containing available location information. Not all attributes may be present for every IP address depending on the database coverage.

      Note: The GeoLocator loads the geolocation database into memory on first use and caches it for subsequent lookups. Lookups are performed using fast binary search on in-memory sorted IP ranges, so additional caching is not necessary.

      Parameters:
      ipAddress - IP address in string format (e.g., "192.168.1.1" or "2001:db8::1")
      Returns:
      Map containing geolocation attributes. Keys are defined as constants in this class (COUNTRY, CITY, etc.). Returns an empty map if the IP address cannot be resolved or no location data is found.
